description: Offer your local changes back to the project — a journal profile you added, a checklist item you fixed, a skill you adapted to your department — as a pull request or an issue, without ever typing a git command. Detects what you changed against the installed version, scans it for patient data and identifiers, shows you every line, and sends nothing until you confirm. Also files feedback: a detector that fired wrongly, a step that failed on your file.
